note: spec 01 §6.3–§6.5, full frames: G = gzip(plaintext) (Go compress/gzip, level 9, mtime 0); the bucket is the smallest with 39 + L + |G| ≤ bucket; R = u32be(|G|) ‖ G ‖ zeros. Byte identity of G across implementations is not required (§6.7): a reader opens each .bin with k_e, the envelope and prev_hash and must get plaintext back exactly. Counters 1, 9, 10 and 99999 give AAD lengths 83, 83, 84 and 87.
